images.prompt: Camera and composition: top-down flat lay view of a table with three to five related objects neatly arranged, no people. Keep the top fifth of the image as softly blurred or plain background (a title band goes there). A bouquet of flowers, a small golden trophy shaped ornament without any text, an envelope and a pair of white gloves on a dark table. Color theme: apricot and ivory tones with a sage green accent. Natural realistic photograph look, soft light, warm mood, natural colors, clean composition. Do not draw any written words, letters or numbers anywhere in the image; signs, labels, screens and papers stay blank or use simple icons only. No money, banknotes, coins or currency symbols anywhere. Do not depict any real or famous person; every face is an ordinary fictional person.
